propositions: Three held-out auth tests replace anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with function objects before pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is imported, causing a TypeError when the provider evaluates its TypeAlias union at first import.

The defect is test isolation, not production validation; the repro requires a specific import order where the patched function is captured in the lazy-loaded module's union before pydantic-ai is imported.
Test doubles must preserve the SDK class contract (not function objects) to avoid breaking the lazy-import union evaluation and allow production auth validation to execute.

The fix changes three function-shaped AsyncAnthropic doubles to class-shaped doubles with fail-if-constructed tripwires, restoring test behavior and contractual secret-redaction without production source changes.
A new oracle test forces provider import in fresh child processes to verify the three affected nodes reach the intended secret-free LLMConfigError rather than a dependency TypeError.
